about: Known architecture debt (tools/dep-check.mjs, D97). The check fails only on violations not listed here; the summary prints the count, which must shrink. Remove an entry when its violation is gone (the check reports it). Never add an entry to make new coupling pass without a review; see modular-kernel-review.md.

rules.core-cycle: No runtime import cycle between files of @aura/core (type-only imports are exempt).
rules.core-module-cycle: No entangled modules in @aura/core: a runtime import A/f -> B/g where g (transitively) imports module A again. Shared contracts belong in leaf files that import no other module.
rules.core-forbidden: @aura/core never imports the shell, the UI, Astro, React, the SDK or the CLI.
rules.package-internals: A package reaches another workspace package only through its declared entry points (package.json `exports`), never by a relative path, `src/` or `dist/`.
rules.sdk-core: @aura/app-sdk imports @aura/core only through its declared entry points and only for types or the declared leaf subpaths (never the kernel root at runtime).
rules.server-webshell: The server layer of @aura/shell (API routes, middleware, server/, and the lib modules they reach) never imports Web Shell code (components, layouts, stores, desktop pages) or UI libraries.
rules.foundation-leaf: Foundation modules of @aura/core (sector map in packages/core/AGENTS.md) import no other sector at runtime, except the barrel (src/index.ts) and the composition root (src/system/bootstrap.ts).
rules.kernel-presentation: Kernel sectors never import presentation-contract modules (theme, layout, keymap) at runtime.
rules.agents-docs: Every AGENTS.md has a sibling CLAUDE.md that is exactly `@AGENTS.md`; the chain of AGENTS.md files from the root to any directory stays under 28 KiB (Codex stops adding files at project_doc_max_bytes, 32 KiB by default); the sector map in packages/core/AGENTS.md names every core module exactly once.

entries.core-cycle: core/src/app-manager/AppMana: 5-main (stream A P5-3, every 5-main stream inherits it): AppManager reaches the Linux identity store through a dynamic import of auth/services, which builds its services from AppManager. Owner: Phase 5b stream K (the identity provider is handed in by the composition root; modular-kernel-review.md §4.1 G1).
entries.core-cycle: core/src/auth/services.ts ->: The other half of the AppManager <-> auth/services file cycle (stream A P5-3). Owner: Phase 5b stream K (modular-kernel-review.md §4.1 G1).
entries.core-module-cycle: core/app-hosts -> cor: app-hosts/lifecycle.ts needs AppIdentity helpers from app-manager while AppManager wires the App Host services: move the identity helpers into a leaf contract file. Owner: Phase 7/8 (D97 module entry points); 5b CR touches the region.
entries.core-module-cycle: core/app-manager -> c: AppManager fetches the App Host singleton (app-hosts/services.ts) itself instead of receiving it from the composition root. Owner: Phase 6 stream K (bootSystem as the composition root).

5-main (streams A, T, C, I.2): AppManager pulls identity, users, grants and audit from auth/services (dynamic imports) instead of receiving them. Owner: Phase 6 stream K (bootSystem wires them; modular-kernel-review.md §4.1 G1).

5-main stream C (not in the review's forecast): AppManager's one-time Phase 5 context migration scans app sources with contract/sourceScan.ts, whose appContract.ts imports app-manager/tool-allowlist.ts. Owner: Phase 6 stream K (the migration is wired by bootSystem with the scanner handed in; or tool-allowlist's pure helpers move to a leaf). Owner decision requested at 5-main.

5-pre/R2: AppManager registers the built-in runtimes, while runtimes/builtins/proot.ts wraps app-manager/ProotRunner.ts. Owner: Phase 5b streams CR and PR (runners move into runtimes/<id>/; acceptance: this entry disappears).
entries.core-module-cycle: core/auth -> core/app: auth/services.ts is a composition root inside the auth module (constructs services from AppManager, capabilities, security). Owner: Phase 6 stream K (composition moves to bootSystem).
entries.core-module-cycle: core/auth -> core/cap: Same composition root (auth/services.ts). Owner: Phase 6 stream K.
entries.core-module-cycle: core/auth -> core/ide: 5-main: auth/services.ts (a composition root inside auth) constructs the Linux identity store. Owner: Phase 6 stream K (composition moves to bootSystem; modular-kernel-review.md §4.1 G1).
entries.core-module-cycle: core/auth -> core/sec: Same composition root (auth/services.ts). Owner: Phase 6 stream K.
entries.core-module-cycle: core/nexus -> core/ap: nexus/removeApp.ts drives AppManager directly (removal orchestration across System Management and Execution). Owner: Phase 7/8 (D97 contracts).
entries.core-module-cycle: core/notifications ->: NotificationService pulls auth/services (and reads the AppManager singleton from globalThis, NotificationService.ts:1729). Owner: Phase 6 stream K (inject the lookups).
entries.core-module-cycle: core/runtimes -> core: The other half: runtimes/builtins/proot.ts imports app-manager/ProotRunner.ts. Owner: Phase 5b streams CR and PR (modular-kernel-review.md §4.1 G1).
entries.foundation-leaf: core/src/types/manifest: The manifest schema (Foundation) validates host names with app-hosts helpers: move the host-name rules (already a leaf, @aura/core/host-rules) under Foundation. Owner: Phase 7 (A1 module entry points).
entries.kernel-presentation: core/src/app-manage: AppManager registers manifest keymaps into the presentation keymap registry. Owner: Phase 8 AppManager decomposition (keymap registration leaves the kernel; headless must not need it).
entries.server-webshell: shell/astro.config.mjs: The one build config always loads React. Owner: Phase 6 stream W (AURA_COMPOSITION=server drops it).
